title: EEG: Alcohol imagery reinforcement learning task with light and heavy drinker participants
description: EEG recordings from 54 community participants classified as light or heavy drinkers performing an affective-state reinforcement learning task involving alcohol imagery. The dataset supports investigation of reward-related neural responses, such as the reward positivity, in relation to drinking behavior. Data were collected between 2019 and 2021.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from community participants (N=54; high and low drinkers) during an affective state reinforcement learning task. Data were collected from 2019 to 2021 in the CRCL at the University of New Mexico.
